mainEntity.name: What can go wrong if the window opening is framed wrong?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risk is framing the opening too small, too large, or without enough structural support. If the header is undersized or the wall is load-bearing, the window may not install correctly and the wall can be compromised. Poor framing can also create air leaks, water intrusion, and finish problems later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bad framing can cause fit issues, structural problems, leaks, and finish damage. Header sizing, load-bearing walls, and exact rough opening dimensions matter most.
